This project has a **moosedev** memory tool exposing recorded project knowledge — architectural
decisions, lessons, constraints, requirements, and patterns — captured by the maintainers.

item.text:
I couldn’t access the moosedev memory tool in this session, so this is grounded in the repo’s public changelog entry `feat(extraction): same-file value-reference edges for impact analysis`.

Codegraph emits value-reference edges so impact analysis catches “change this constant/table/global, break the functions that read it,” a case ordinary caller/callee edges miss. It keeps them precise by limiting them to same-file references, adding no extra graph nodes, and skipping bundled/minified files or names whose shadowing makes resolution ambiguous.
